title: One-of-a-Kind Home in Harker Heights, TX
description:
Everyday feels like a getaway at 2201 Fuller Lane. This one-of-a-kind contemporary Texas lakehouse offers a rare blend of character, comfort and natural beauty—just a short walk through your wooded backyard to Stillhouse Lake. With deer and wildlife as your neighbors, you'll feel worlds away while still being conveniently located just off 2484 with easy access to Salado and FM 2410. Spanning three levels, this extraordinary home features 4 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, designed with both function and flair. On the top level, the expansive primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings, french doors leading to a private covered balcony with built-in bar and an en-suite bath complete with garden tub, separate shower and dual vanities. A second bedroom upstairs is ideal for a nursery, office or flex space. The main floor is perfect for entertaining with its open-concept living room, cozy fireplace, huge corner windows and a breakfast bar that seamlessly connects the kitchen and dining area. A second balcony offers treehouse-like views and a peaceful place to unwind. Downstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath—perfect for guests, teens, or multi-generational living. If you're looking for a truly unique home full of updates, character and proximity to nature, THIS IS IT. Don’t miss your chance to own this unforgettable retreat!
